📦 Bulk & Corporate

Ordering for a crowd

Office parties, weddings, mehndis, school events and shop counters. Tell us the headcount and the date and we will bake to it.

What we can do

  • 25–50 brownies — 2 days' notice. Mixed flavours at no extra cost.
  • 50–150 brownies — 3–4 days' notice, so every tray is still baked fresh rather than made early and stored.
  • 150+ — talk to us. We will tell you honestly whether we can bake it well by your date. We would rather turn an order down than send out something that sat for two days.

Pricing

Bulk pricing depends on quantity, flavour mix and how much notice you can give us, so we quote per order rather than publishing a rate card we would have to keep breaking. Expect a meaningful discount on the menu price once you pass 25 pieces.

Payment

Still Cash on Delivery, same as every other order. For large trays we may ask to confirm the order by phone the day before, purely so nobody bakes 150 brownies for an address that changed.

Individually boxed?

Yes — useful for corporate gifting and event giveaways. Ask when you enquire; it changes the price a little and the lead time slightly.

Ask for a quote

The more of this you can tell us, the faster we can answer:

  • How many brownies, roughly
  • The date you need them
  • Flavours, or "mixed"
  • Delivery area in Lahore
  • Individually boxed, or trays
